notes: Synthetic: authored from OpenRouter's OpenAPI spec as vendored in its official SDK, github.com/OpenRouterTeam/python-sdk .speakeasy/in.openapi.yaml at 328d3cac (2026-10-28; pinned as contractspec/subsets/openrouter): ChatResult, ChatStreamingResponse (whose data is the chunk), ChatAssistantMessage (reasoning, reasoning_details of type reasoning.text with signature and format), ChatUsage (cost, is_byok, cost_details, prompt_tokens_details with cache_write_tokens), and the error responses of POST /chat/completions with their examples. openrouter.ai was not reachable from the authoring sandbox. Naming: the openrouter preset (providers/presets.go) serving anthropic/claude-4.5-sonnet, the model the SDK README uses; the directory is that key as contracttest.ModelDir encodes it. Error bodies are the spec's examples verbatim (integer code). The mid-stream error chunk follows ChatStreamingResponse, which carries error {code, message, metadata {error_type, provider_code}} beside the chunk fields and finish_reason "error". Not covered: message.images (OR3), embeddings usage (OR4, pinned by openrouter@openai/text-embedding-3-small) and finish_reason "error" without an error object (OR6), all in testdata/spec_allowlist.openrouter.json. list_models drives ListModels (GET /models, from the same spec at 752139b7, pinned as contractspec/subsets/openrouter): the 200 example verbatim (ModelsListResponse: data alone, no object; each model's catalog metadata beside id and created), filed here because the request names no model. list_models_error_unauthorized is the operation's 401 example verbatim: ListModels reads no error body at all (gap O33), so the case's body is opaque and its golden the plain Go error.

allowed_type_mismatches.reason: known gap OR1: OpenRouter's error code is an integer (the HTTP status) and models.ErrorDetail.Code a string, so parseProviderError cannot decode any OpenRouter error body and falls back to a 502: a 400, 401, 402 or 429 is retried, failed over and counted against the circuit breaker, and the client gets the raw body as the message
